text:
maria: Quick async standup for docs/devex — SDKs, quickstarts, and sample apps. Post 1) what you did yesterday, 2) blockers, 3) today. Keep it short :slightly_smiling_face:

lina: Did: updated python quickstart to the new streaming endpoint and added a short section on best-practices for prefix caching. Pushed PR: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/PR-422.
Blocker: sample-app (node) auth starts returning 401 when using KMS-issued short lived tokens — happens intermittently.
Today: reproduce locally + add an integration test that captures the 401 case.

sam: Did: merged TS SDK tool-calling typings and added examples for function schema validation. PR #430 merged.
Blocker: need a tiny docs snippet showing `client.withTools()` usage for the quickstart page.
Today: add the snippet and ping @lina for placement in the python/node quickstarts.

ben: Did: updated sample-app-go Dockerfile to include ca-certificates and bumped go mod for compatibility.
Blocker: CI on macOS matrix is flaky — unrelated to my change but blocks green builds. Filed CI ticket: https://git.redwood/infra/issue/618.
Today: try reproducing the macOS runner failure locally, and if not possible, comment on infra ticket.

olivia: Did: fixed a couple of doc typos and replaced a stale screenshot on the quickstart page.
Blocker: none.
Today: review PRs 422 and 431 (quickstarts + sample app fixes) and merge if green.

ci-bot: build: PR 430 — success ✅ (tests: 178 passed, 2 skipped).

maria: Notes: @lina if KMS tokens are flaky, as a dev workaround set `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=dev_local_key` and run the sample app. Also please add `docs-changes` label to any SDK/quickstart PRs so they show up in the release notes.

sam: @ben @olivia — could you take a 5min look at PR 422? It's the python quickstart update + small example snippet. 

lina: Thanks — I'll add a failing unit test and a small patch to sample-app to refresh tokens on 401. @maria adding `docs-changes` now.

maria: Perfect. If anyone needs a hand with the auth repro, ping me here and I can hop on a short call. :thumbsup:
